name: hometable-bot
description: Home Table — a Telegram bot that tracks who's eating at home for which meals, so nobody has to ask in the group chat.

bindings.BOT_TOKEN: Your Telegram bot's token from @BotFather — see the README for how to get one
bindings.WEBHOOK_SECRET: Any random string you make up — keeps your bot's webhook URL private
bindings.WIDGET_KEY: Optional — only needed for the home-screen widget. Any random string you make up
